decision: Preserve the two E0 signals and their exact diagnostics, but do not promote, confirm or prepare a PR. The campaign found no target-attributable transfer for either historical fault in the fixed sample.
limitations: The historical Nanoda pair contains multiple source changes, so differing verdicts require diagnostic/source qualification. This review identifies the branch emitting the exact observed rejection; it does not claim whole-program dynamic tracing, general semantic correctness or equivalence outside these inputs.

prior_characterization.matrix_observation: Official Lean and Kiota accept both possibly-Prop cases; Nanoda and Lean4Lean reject both. All implementations reject the definite-Prop data case, and all accept the matched control.
prior_characterization.rationale: Arena PRs #167 and #171 explain and permit the conservative possibly-Prop profile with outcome either.

review_scope: Causal qualification of the two differing verdicts; E0 only.

source_review.causal_assessment: Both raw differences are attributable to the separate possibly-Prop projection policy present in the same historical revision interval. The observations do not demonstrate that either input exercises or detects the target def_eq_proj identity fault.
source_review.observed_rejection_branch: The fixed revision changes infer_proj from is_proposition(structure_ty) to may_be_prop(structure_ty), and the exact fixed diagnostics are the panic emitted by this branch.
source_review.target_fault_branch: The historical projection-structure identity fix is a separate def_eq_proj change that adds equality of projection ty_name fields.
